questions.question: What was the apparent root cause of the outage?
What was the actual root cause?
questions.gold_answer: A missing database index, dropped by a schema migration two days earlier, which made one query take ~8 seconds and hold connections open.

questions.question: Was connection pool exhaustion the cause of the outage or a symptom of something else?
questions.gold_answer: A symptom — it was downstream of the slow query, which was itself downstream of the migration.

questions.question: Did raising the connection pool size fix the underlying problem?
questions.gold_answer: No — it only reduced how often the symptom surfaced; the slow-query behavior kept recurring until the index was added.

questions.question: Did the pool-size increase happen before or after the slow query was identified as the real problem?
questions.gold_answer: Before — the pool was raised at 14:24, and the slow query was found later by a secondary investigation running in parallel.
